post.text:
Elon trying to get invited to Epstein's island:

Video by @munchy_monk /TikTok https://t.co/s4VroEFcHT

description.description: A young man wears a black fedora and oversized black blazer. Text overhead reads 'Elon Musk in the Files:' as the man speaks to the camera in various poses.

tweetMedia.transcription: Hello, Jeff. I heard you're having le epic parties on your island, and I can't think of anyone more deserving of an invite than the meme lord himself. Would love to hear back from you. Dear Big Steve, it appears my last message never got through. After a long day of being real-life Iron Man, I too would like to party and let loose with a bunch of young babes. When's the wildest party you're throwing? I'll be there. Merry Christmas, Big Jeffy. I know it's 6 a.m. and my family's in the other room, But I'd really love to visit the island. And trust me, a peaceful island experience is the opposite of what I'm looking for. Hey, Elon. Looks like the UN is meeting this Friday. And let's just say there'll be a lot of interesting people at my place. UN? Oh, sorry. I run two large companies, and I'm about to launch arguably the most advanced rocket of all time. Watching diplomats do nothing seems like a silly use of my time. Are you fucking stupid? I'm talking about children. God, you're so annoying. This is why we never invite you.
